name: Northbridge tissue-tile classifier (teaching model)
architecture: small CNN (5 conv layers with batch norm), 28×28 input
source: MedMNIST v3, Zenodo 10519652, pathmnist.npz (CC BY 4.0); derived from NCT-CRC-HE-100K
limits: Teaching model: not validated for diagnosis.
Trained only on H&E colorectal tissue tiles: any other image is out of scope, but the model will still output 9 probabilities that sum to 1.
Confidence is not correctness: a high probability can still be wrong.
